beats.narration_slice: Seawater has too much salt for your body.
beats.visual: Full-bleed retro educational illustration of a shallow tide pool evaporating beside the open ocean, with pale salt crystals crusting the rocks and concentrated brine glinting under hard tropical sun.
beats.purpose: show that seawater contains a heavy salt load unsuitable for normal hydration
beats.visual_fingerprint: macro shoreline detail + visible salt crust and brine + low rock-level angle + harsh sunlit tide-pool zone + diagonal ocean edge composition
beats.continuity: begin inside the island environment with a close physical example of seawater salinity

beats.narration_slice: Your kidneys use water to remove that salt.
beats.visual: Full-bleed field-guide-style anatomical cutaway of a human torso centered against a softly abstracted island backdrop, kidneys emphasized naturally as water flows through the urinary system with no labels or text.
beats.purpose: show that the kidneys require body water to excrete excess salt
beats.visual_fingerprint: anatomical torso cutaway + kidneys processing water + straight-on medium framing + simplified interior-body setting + centered symmetrical composition
beats.continuity: shift from the salty environment to the body's internal response

beats.narration_slice: Drink seawater, and you may lose more water than you gain.
beats.visual: A weathered castaway crouches beside the surf after drinking from cupped hands, while an almost-empty freshwater gourd lies nearby and the blazing shoreline stretches behind them, emphasizing worsening dehydration rather than relief.
beats.purpose: visually pay off that drinking seawater can worsen net water loss
beats.visual_fingerprint: dehydrated castaway + drinking at surf edge + wide three-quarter shoreline view + exposed blazing beach + empty freshwater vessel as symbolic object
beats.continuity: return from internal physiology to the practical survival consequence on the beach

beats.narration_slice: Rain can help if you collect it.
beats.visual: During a slate-gray tropical shower, broad palm leaves and a stretched scrap of cloth funnel rainwater into a clean container set on sand, with droplets visibly converging toward the catch vessel.
beats.purpose: show rainwater collection as a usable freshwater opportunity
beats.visual_fingerprint: rain-catching cloth and palm leaves + water funneling into container + high three-quarter angle + storm-dark beach clearing + converging V-shaped composition
beats.continuity: move from failed seawater hydration to a viable freshwater source

beats.narration_slice: Some islands have springs or fresh groundwater.
beats.visual: A shaded rocky interior hollow where clear freshwater seeps naturally from a stone face into a small pool beneath dense island scrub, with the ocean only faintly visible far below.
beats.purpose: show that certain islands can contain natural springs or accessible fresh groundwater
beats.visual_fingerprint: rock spring seep + clear pool + low upward angle + shaded inland ravine + water emerging from stone as focal reveal
beats.continuity: travel inland from temporary rainfall collection to a possible natural freshwater source

beats.narration_slice: Others may have no reliable fresh water.
beats.visual: A high overhead view of a small dry island surrounded by turquoise ocean, its interior showing sun-baked scrub, bare rock, and an empty cracked rain basin with no stream or spring visible.
beats.purpose: show that an island may lack any dependable freshwater source
beats.visual_fingerprint: entire dry island + empty cracked catch basin + bird's-eye scale + cloudless drought conditions + isolated island centered in surrounding sea
beats.continuity: contrast the spring-bearing island with a different island that is visibly dry

beats.narration_slice: Desalination can turn seawater into fresh water.
beats.visual: At the shoreline, a compact improvised desalination setup draws seawater through tubing and a condensation chamber, producing a small stream of clear water into a separate vessel.
beats.purpose: show desalination converting seawater into freshwater
beats.visual_fingerprint: desalination apparatus + seawater intake and clear-water output + eye-level close-medium shot + rocky shore work area + left-to-right process composition
beats.continuity: introduce a technological solution after the dry-island limitation

beats.narration_slice: But it needs equipment, energy, and care.
beats.visual: A wider worksite view shows the same class of desalination system surrounded by a solar panel, fuel or power components, tools, replacement filters, and a person carefully maintaining a fouled intake near the surf.
beats.purpose: show the material, energy, and maintenance requirements of desalination
beats.visual_fingerprint: maintenance worker and desalination gear + cleaning clogged intake + wide oblique worksite shot + equipment-strewn coastal shelf + solar panel and tools forming foreground anchors
beats.continuity: expand from the clean conversion process to the support systems required to keep it operating

beats.narration_slice: Food, injury, disease, and aging still matter.
beats.visual: A full-bleed island survival scene at dusk shows four distinct but naturally integrated pressures: sparse edible plants and an empty fishing line, a bandaged leg, a feverish resting figure under a palm shelter, and an older survivor moving slowly with a driftwood staff.
beats.purpose: show that freshwater does not eliminate other long-term survival limits
beats.visual_fingerprint: multiple survival pressures + scarce food, injury care, illness and aging + broad dusk tableau + inland camp zone + layered foreground-to-background human needs
beats.continuity: widen beyond water technology to the remaining limits on long-term survival

beats.narration_slice: Even perfect fresh water cannot make island life last forever.
beats.visual: At sunset, a pristine vessel overflowing with clear freshwater sits in the foreground while an aging, weather-beaten island camp and exhausted survivors recede toward the horizon, the abundant water visibly unable to solve every other need.
beats.purpose: close on the idea that unlimited freshwater alone cannot guarantee indefinite island survival
beats.visual_fingerprint: overflowing freshwater vessel versus failing camp + no active water collection + low foreground-heavy angle + amber sunset shoreline + symbolic contrast between abundant water and declining human condition
beats.continuity: remain in the island world and distill the preceding survival pressures into one final contrast
